correctness.rationale: Affine reduction preserves independent uniform side fractions and area ratio. The exact area polynomial has T=H(w-w0), Q positive bounded by one; the conditional w-length has a universal sqrt(epsilon) tube with integrable 2/H dominator. Two explicit changes of coordinates convert the coarea integrand to (sin alpha+sin beta+sin gamma)/8, whose integral is 3*pi/8; hence 3*pi/4. Signed normalized deficit yields L1 convergence on compact domains, with 1/H controlling tails. The acute law 1/pi follows by explicit angle-domain integration. The included checker independently compares intersections and quadrature; finite computations are not proofs.

value.rationale: Concurrency of three independently generated cevians is a classical affine-invariant geometry event. The sharp, parent-shape-free 3*pi/4 probability coefficient is a nontrivial exact geometric tube-volume invariant, and the conditional auxiliary-angle and signed-deficit laws identify where and how rare near-concurrence arises. The sine weighting and acute probability 1/pi are concrete geometric statistics, not renamings of the deterministic Routh formula.
